title: Connect Finance Church Report Trend v1
description: The full multi-year Church operating trend (finance_church_entries, period_month=0 rows only): every fiscal year on file, each independently precedence-resolved the same way connect.finance-church-report.v1 resolves one fiscal year (resolveChurchYearPrecedence -- CHURCH_SOURCE_PRIORITY picks one source WHOLESALE per year), then rolled up with computeYearSummary(). Takes no parameters -- the trend is inherently the whole history, not one period a caller names. netIncomeActualCents is the same full bottom-line figure (Income - Cost of Goods Sold - Expenses, plus Other Income - Other Expenses) production's own existing multi-year trend chart/table already shows, not a naive income-minus-expense simplification. Deliberately actual-only: production's own multi-year view never shows a budget column or series.

years.description: Ascending fiscal-year order. May legitimately be empty if finance_church_entries has no annual (period_month=0) rows at all yet -- a normal state, not an error, the same honesty the single-year contract applies to one empty fiscal year.

incomeActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Income' only for this fiscal year, after precedence resolution -- matches production's 'Total revenue' card for the same year exactly; does not include Other Income.

expenseActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Expenses' only -- does not include Other Expenses or Cost of Goods Sold.

otherIncomeActualCents.description: Carried so the consumer can independently re-derive netIncomeActualCents rather than trust it blindly. Nonzero in real production data for some fiscal years (confirmed 2026-09-15).

costOfGoodsSoldActualCents.description: 0 in every real fiscal year checked so far (this church has never posted to a Cost of Goods Sold account), but carried defensively -- valid QuickBooks output, not schema-forbidden.

netIncomeActualCents.description: The full reconciled bottom line: (incomeActualCents - costOfGoodsSoldActualCents - expenseActualCents) + (otherIncomeActualCents - otherExpenseActualCents). Matches production's own 'Net Income' multi-year trend row/chart series exactly (src/frontend/js-finance.js's finRenderChurchMultiYear) -- provably different from a naive incomeActualCents-minus-expenseActualCents figure in fiscal years with nonzero Other Income/Expenses.

accountCount.description: Number of precedence-resolved accounts for this fiscal year -- may legitimately be 0 for a year with nothing synced or imported yet.
